achievements.name: Bird Watcher
achievements.reward: All birds turn shiny gold and leave sparkles

achievements.name: Cryptid Hunter
achievements.reward: A rare white yeti sometimes peeks instead

achievements.name: Caffeinated
achievements.reward: The cup becomes an enamel camp mug

achievements.name: Smoke Break
achievements.reward: An ashtray appears on the sill

achievements.desc: Read every tab in the folder
achievements.reward: The folder gets a gold REVIEWED seal

achievements.name: Night Owl
achievements.reward: Shooting stars cross the night sky

achievements.desc: See morning, day, afternoon and night

sasquatch_wave.note: Reward 1. Replaces sasquatch_peek after the first click: he rises, waves twice, blinks and sinks.

yeti_peek.note: Reward 3. A rare white yeti that peeks in place of the sasquatch.

yeti_wave.note: Reward 3 with reward 1: the yeti waves too.

bird_flap_shiny.note: Reward 2. Golden bird; use instead of bird_flap once unlocked. Leave a sparkle behind it every few frames.

sparkle.note: A twinkle that plays once and disappears. Used for the shiny bird trail and on the trophy.

mug_camp.note: Reward 4. White enamel camp mug with a navy rim and a pine tree; drop-in replacement for mug.

ashtray.note: Reward 5. Static sill item between the pack and the folder: a ceramic ashtray with ash, two butts and one tip still glowing.

trophy.note: Reward 13. A two-handled gold cup on a wooden base, at the left of the sill; its top stands in front of the bottom of the view. Spawn a sparkle on it now and then.

folder_reviewed_overlay.note: Reward 6. A gold seal with a tick; draw it directly over the closed folder sprite (same size and anchor). Hide it while the folder is open.

shooting_star.note: Reward 7. Night only. A streak falling down and to the left, then fading. Plays once at a random spot.

aurora.note: Reward 8. Night only. A slow 60-frame loop (about 10 seconds) of three layered curtains with rising rays, green at the lower edge fading through teal to violet. Draw under the stars, clipped by the sky mask. Fade the whole layer in and out over several seconds; never cut it on or off.

rainbow.note: Reward 9. A translucent arc over the waterfall. Fade it in when rain stops and out after about 20 seconds. Draw after the waterfall and before the near forest.

constellation_sasquatch.note: Reward 10. Night only. A striding figure picked out in stars and faint lines, in the upper left of the sky.

placement.path: feet on y=123, enters from x 128 and stops near x 148

deer_walk.note: Reward 12. Faces right; mirror to walk left.

deer_graze.note: Reward 12. Stands, lowers its head to the water, looks up, flicks its tail. Then walk on or back.

mug_camp_sip.note: The same sip for the enamel camp mug. Plays once when the mug is clicked. Hide the static mug and its steam while it plays, then show them again. The mug lifts, comes toward the viewer, tips at the bottom edge of the screen, and returns. Draw above everything else.

folder_reviewed.note: Reward 6. The closed folder with the gold seal already on it; use in place of folder once Case Closed is earned.

folder_reviewed_open.note: Reward 6. The gold-seal folder opens. Same size, anchor and timing as folder_open, so it is a drop-in swap; the seal stays on the cover as it tips.

folder_reviewed_close.note: Reward 6. The gold-seal folder closes. Same size, anchor and timing as folder_open, so it is a drop-in swap; the seal stays on the cover as it tips.

folder_reviewed_place.note: Reward 6. The gold-seal folder sliding up onto the sill, for the whoami command. Same box, frames and timing as folder_place, so it is a drop-in swap; show folder_reviewed once it ends.
